title: heliotropium micranthos
intro: Heliotropium micranthos, commonly known as heliotrope or small-flowered heliotrope, is a flowering plant species in the family Boraginaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, due to its health benefits, such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Heliotropium micranthos include cough suppression, bronchodilation, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents responsible for its properties include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been identified through phytochemical analysis.
